name: PulseGear — Full-Stack E-Commerce
desc: Enterprise e-commerce engine with atomic inventory locking, Stripe PaymentIntents & webhooks, JWT auth, OpenAPI docs, Redux store, and a modern Tailwind UI. Deployed on Render with Docker & PostgreSQL.

name: DevMetrics
desc: Engineering productivity dashboard that aggregates GitHub analytics—commit trends, PR cycle times, top repositories, and an automated productivity score—via OAuth 2.0 and GraphQL, with server-side caching to manage API rate limits.

name: Pneumonia Detection System
desc: End-to-end deep learning pipeline detecting pneumonia in pediatric chest X-rays with 99% Recall. Deployed as a FastAPI microservice with interactive React frontend for real-time inference.

name: JobTracker Pro
desc: Full-stack application tracker featuring an interactive 5-stage Kanban board, real-time conversion analytics, JWT authentication, search & filters, and automated Vitest test suites. Deployed on Render with MongoDB Atlas.

name: Recipe Finder & Meal Planner
desc: Modern culinary platform featuring dual-mode recipe search, fridge ingredient matcher, interactive cook mode with kitchen timer, dynamic servings scaler, and smart grocery list. Powered by Angular 20 Signals and secure Vercel Serverless API proxy.
